label: The reaper never handled git fsmonitor daemons. sk-git/026's recorded daemon-orphan detection was memory-launcher (MCP) daemon handling (REAP_DAEMONS, _daemon_worktree_path_from_cmdline, _daemon_cmdline_is_orphan) that commit 3c7c3f83874 removed together with the memory launcher itself; git log -S fsmonitor over .skilled/bin and .opencode/bin returns no commit at all.

speckit.worktreeBase is a local-only git-config key that was never committed; the launch wrapper persists it when unset, the changelog documents unsetting it to return to in-checkout .worktrees, and no script unsets it. The current config has no speckit.* keys, so the ~/worktrees/public relocation was lost outside version control and nothing re-establishes it.

Worktree creation still defaults to .worktrees/ inside the checkout: worktree-naming.sh resolves env SPECKIT_WORKTREE_BASE > config speckit.worktreeBase > .worktrees, and all 12 registered task worktrees are back under Public/.worktrees/ with worktrees/NNN-slug branches.

The 30-minute stall chain: pre-push hook to ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs to generate-leaf-manifest.cjs dropGitIgnoredLeaves to spawnSync('git', ['check-ignore','-z','--stdin']) with no timeout. check-ignore consults the index, triggering refresh_fsmonitor IPC; the existing fallback only fires on error or non-0/1 exit, and a hang is neither.

fsmonitor opt-out precedents exist (alignment-lib.cjs uses -c core.fsmonitor=false; continuity-freshness defines GIT_NO_FSMONITOR; git-context-extractor uses a 5s timeout) but are not applied at the unguarded index-reading call sites: generate-leaf-manifest.cjs:129, regenerate-skill-derived.cjs:73, verify-router-sync.cjs:168, folder-detector.js:250, collect-session-data.ts:1164, git-standards.cjs:88, git-hook-gates.cjs:86,95, write-containment.ts:431, score-fanout-pairs.cjs:743, heal-spec-docs.cjs:1264, behavior-bench-run.cjs:885, resolve-authority-root.ts:36, resolve-cutover-binding.ts:99.

Lead to verify in iteration 2: git check-ignore accepts --no-index to skip the index read entirely, which would remove the fsmonitor dependency at the three check-ignore call sites without changing their semantics for untracked-path checks. Not yet confirmed against git 2.50.1 docs.
